```{r, echo = FALSE, appendix = FALSE}
if (type == 'Existing'){
  df = data
  if (any(df$emissions == 0)){
    zero_warn = TRUE
  } else {
    zero_warn = FALSE
  }
  df = MACT_existing(CAA_section = CAA_section, data = df, 
                     emissions = 'emissions', sources = 'sources',
                     national_N = national_N)
  df_mean = df %>% group_by(sources) %>% 
                              summarize(means = mean(emissions), 
                                        counts = n())
  if (all(df_mean$counts == 1)){
  source_fig = FALSE
} else {
  source_fig = TRUE
}
} else if (type == "New"){
  df = data
  if (any(df$emissions == 0)){
    zero_warn = TRUE
  } else {
    zero_warn = FALSE
  }
  source_fig = FALSE
  df = MACT_new(data = df,  emissions = 'emissions', sources = 'sources')
} else if (type == "As-is"){
  df = data
  if (any(df$emissions == 0)){
    zero_warn = TRUE
  } else {
    zero_warn = FALSE
  }
  df_mean = df %>% group_by(sources) %>% 
                              summarize(means = mean(emissions), 
                                        counts = n())
  if (all(df_mean$counts == 1)){
    source_fig = FALSE
  } else {
    source_fig = TRUE
  }
}
best_source = as.character(df$sources)[1]
df$ln_emiss = log(df$emissions)
df$ln_emiss = replace(df$ln_emiss, !is.finite(df$ln_emiss), NA)
distribution_result = distribution_type(data = df, emissions = 'emissions')
if (distribution_result == "Normal"){
  UPL = Normal_UPL(data = df,
                   emissions = 'emissions',
                   significance = significance,
                   future_runs = future_runs)
} else if (distribution_result == "Lognormal"){
  UPL = Lognormal_UPL(data = df,
                      emissions = 'emissions',
                      significance = significance,
                      future_runs = future_runs)  
} else if (distribution_result == "Skewed"){
  UPL = Skewed_UPL(data = df,
                   emissions = 'emissions',
                   significance = significance,
                   future_runs = future_runs)  
}
if (!is.na(subcat_name)){
  subcat_text = paste0('for ', subcat_name, ' subcategory ', subcat_level)
} else {
  subcat_text = ''
}
```
